title: On upper bounds of frieze patterns

source.citation: J. Cheah, A. de Saint Germain, On upper bounds of frieze patterns, arXiv 2024
source.evidence: README: 'A Latex file with the exact statements is available ... in the note On upper bounds in frieze patterns'; arXiv comment: 'Note associated to a Lean4 formalisation project'. Paper and blueprint written together.
